description: The dawn of empires. Across a world still trackless and unclaimed, eight cities kindle the first fires of civilization — each a single walled town with a hinterland to tame. Send out colonists and armies to settle neighbouring lands, raise walls against rivals, and grow a lone city into an empire that spans the map. There are no borders yet but the ones you draw.
heroSubtitle: Eight cities. One world to claim.
name: Pax Colonia
subtitle: Dawn of Empires — c. 500 BCE
